description: Make a print-ready design from a short description, for one item in one color. Returns a watermarked preview of the design on the item, a design_id for revise_design and open_in_studio, and how many free designs are left. Describe the ARTWORK only ("a snarling wolf head, two colors"), not the garment: the garment is chosen with `item` and `color`. Each call makes one design and spends one from the allowance (10 as a visitor, then 25 a day on an aipromodesign.com account). Pass back the `visitor` value from the previous answer so the allowance follows the customer.

brief.description: What the artwork shows, in the customer's words. The artwork alone - no shirt, no mug.

color.description: The item's color by name (Navy, Black, White, Forest Green, Sport Gray, Red, Royal, Maroon...). Defaults to White.

item.description: Item key or the word a customer would use (tee, hoodie, mug, tote, cap, polo, long sleeve, crewneck, performance tee, women's tee, youth hoodie, notebook, tumbler). Use list_items for the full set. Defaults to the adult tee.

surface.description: Which print area: front (default), back, left_sleeve, right_sleeve. The design is sized for it.

visitor.description: The visitor value from an earlier answer in this conversation, if there was one.

name: design_item
title: Design artwork for an item
